# BenSimple

BenSimple is Ben LaVelle's personal automotive brand in Butte, Montana. Butte Auto is the dealership affiliation and official inventory source.

Official website: https://www.bensimple.co/
Contact: ben@bensimple.co or 406-399-5959
Official inventory: https://www.butteauto.com/all-inventory/index.htm

BenSimple helps customers narrow a vehicle search, prepare a trade or sale, ask automotive questions, decode VINs with official NHTSA vPIC data, review NHTSA model-level recall information, and request an appointment with Ben.

Important limits:
- BenSimple does not publish or quote dealership prices, MSRP, rebates, incentives, monthly payments, trade values, or financing guarantees.
- Inventory availability and current details must be verified by Ben.
- Appointment requests remain pending until Ben confirms them personally.
- Recall information is attributed to NHTSA and should be confirmed for a specific VIN through NHTSA or an authorized dealer.

Primary pages:
- Home and assistant: https://www.bensimple.co/
- Privacy and disclosures: https://www.bensimple.co/legal
